gate.method: small prime: every class is needed, unit-orbit representatives

claim: Assuming LRC(m) for all m < 15 (arXiv:2609.02604v2), every primitive counterexample v to LRC(15) (15 speeds, 16 runners) with pairwise distinct coordinates has 29 | v_1...v_15. Every level-one cover modulo 29 contains all 14 classes; each of its lifts at level 128 is (15,29,128)-proper (witness on the 1/(128*29) grid or the gcd clause) or satisfies the power-of-two shift lemma (some d = 2^j, 2 <= j <= 7); 0 lifts of the orbit representatives use the lemma, so this is the divisibility of Lemma 2.2(ii) of arXiv:2609.02604v2.
